L.183/608/B.5b.

14th October, 1938.

Dear Blank,

I return herewith, with many thanks, the passport papers relating to Arthur William OLDAG, which were forwarded under your letter HB. of 13.10.38. I am very grateful to you for your assistance in this matter.

Yours sincerely,

H. Blank, Esq.,
PASSPORT OFFICE.
